levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري
عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الأصم

notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» is kept as a back_reference, not inherited: prev1 has four co-transmitters at its first level (جميعا), so the names it stands for are not taken over (several routes); the reader does not guess them.

The Imam «أبي عبد الله (ع)» is named in the words after each chain, so each route ends with him as imam_in_text (owner ruling 2). The occurrence 2 «حضرة أبي عبد الله الحسين» in the supplication is not a link.
«وَ ذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ» gives a second isnad for the same saying, so it is a second group, not a variant.
